summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX plan for launching the /cv-templates canonical SEO hub and 7 targeted UK CV template category landing pages (/cv-template-16-year-old, /school-leaver-cv-template, /graduate-cv-templates, /acting-cv-template, /finance-cv-template, /nursing-cv-template, and /ats-friendly-cv-template). Covers permanent redirect from legacy /templates, bespoke UK niche CV layouts and authentic British sample CVs, direct-to-builder template activation, hub-and-spoke internal linking, and full Schema.org JSON-LD + OpenGraph metadata.
